TERMS AND CONDITIONS
This agreement is between the supplier and the customer.
Payment is due within 30 days of the invoice date. Late fees apply after 45 days.

DELIVERY
Goods are delivered within 10 business days of the order. Risk passes on delivery.

TERMINATION
Either party may terminate with 60 days written notice. Fees already paid are not refunded.

CONFIDENTIALITY
Each party keeps the other's information confidential for five years after the agreement ends.
